summary: Tested Segnalatori extensions end-to-end: admin-only Excel export, segnalatore filter, date-range calendar filter (Europe/Rome), stats dashboard per role, plus regressions (create, esito, BO sidebar badge). Backend: 19/19 new pytest + 17/17 regression from test_segnalazioni.py (upload + user creation deselected). Frontend: everything requested works for admin, BO and segnalatore. No critical bugs; only minor UX notes.

minor.issue: Cell values are not sanitized against CSV/Excel formula injection (nome/note starting with '=', '+', '-', '@'). Low risk because openpyxl writes them as strings unless they start with '='; consider prefixing with an apostrophe.
For admin, only role=segnalatore users are listed, so segnalazioni created by admin itself cannot be filtered by creator. Probably acceptable.

integration_issues.issue: load() in Segnalazioni.jsx has no try/catch: an API error (e.g. 400/500) causes an unhandled promise rejection, the loading state never resets, and no toast is shown.

issues: When only one day is picked the label says 'Dal 27/10/2026' (from...), but the filter actually applies to that single day only (date_to = from). Suggest the label '27/10/2026' or making 'from' open-ended.
In the 2-month calendar, outside days (e.g. 27 Oct shown inside the November grid) get the 'today' highlight; consider showOutsideDays={false} or styling day_outside today differently.
The search placeholder mentions 'segnalatore' even for the segnalatore role, which only sees its own records.

The UI formatDate uses the browser timezone (14:00 shown in a UTC browser) while Excel uses Europe/Rome (15:00). Consistent per design, but it can confuse users outside Italy and ignores the app's 'Fuso orario' setting.

action_items: Optional: wrap load() in Segnalazioni.jsx in try/catch/finally and show an error toast
Optional: fix the single-day date label ('Dal X' vs single-day filter)
Optional: sanitize Excel cells starting with '=' against formula injection
critical_code_review_comments: _filters_query correctly ANDs scope with filters, so a segnalatore cannot read others' data via segnalatore_id (verified)
The export endpoint checks the role after _filters_query runs; fine, because _scope_query allows admin
Date boundaries compare ISO strings; this works because every created_at is written with datetime.isoformat() in UTC (+00:00)
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed segnalazioni were created during the tests and then deleted via pymongo. Existing data (Mario TestSegn OK, Luca Contatore NR) left untouched. No passwords changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login uses #username + input[type=password]; navigate with get_by_role('button', name='Segnalatori'). The date calendar is a radix popover: use [data-radix-popper-content-wrapper] get_by_role('gridcell', name='N'). The system date in this environment is 27/10/2026. The export downloads via blob (page.expect_download works). The new pytest file test_segnalazioni_export_stats.py cleans TEST_ data automatically.
